summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting fiscal Q4/year-end results and announcing board actions: a quarterly dividend of $1.09 per share payable October 5, 2026, representing a 12% annual dividend increase to $4.36 per share, plus a new $1.5 billion share repurchase authorization with no expiration, replacing a prior program. The repurchases may occur via open market, private, or Rule 10b5-1 transactions. No deal terms typical of M&A apply. Watch for execution pace and balance-sheet impact.
